_说明: 「粉碎和富集矿石块」等任务的三个任务物品是 ftbfiltersystem:smart_filter，名字（Crushers／Enrichers／Smelters）写死在物品的 minecraft:custom_name 组件里，不走任务书语言键，只能改章节文件本身。每个过滤器匹配一台机器加四级工厂，译名据此写成「机器或工厂」，机器名取自 mekanism 的物品真名。

replace: item: { components: { "ftbfiltersystem:filter": "or(item(mekanism:crusher)item(mekanism:basic_crushing_factory)item(mekanism:advanced_crushing_factory)item(mekanism:elite_crushing_factory)item(mekanism:ultimate_crushing_factory))", "minecraft:custom_name": "\"粉碎机或粉碎工厂\"" }, count: 1, id: "ftbfiltersystem:smart_filter" }

item: { components: { "ftbfiltersystem:filter": "or(item(mekanism:enrichment_chamber)item(mekanism:basic_enriching_factory)item(mekanism:advanced_enriching_factory)item(mekanism:elite_enriching_factory)item(mekanism:ultimate_enriching_factory))", "minecraft:custom_name": "\"富集仓或富集工厂\"" }, count: 1, id: "ftbfiltersystem:smart_filter" }

item: { components: { "ftbfiltersystem:filter": "or(item(mekanism:energized_smelter)item(mekanism:basic_smelting_factory)item(mekanism:advanced_smelting_factory)item(mekanism:elite_smelting_factory)item(mekanism:ultimate_smelting_factory))", "minecraft:custom_name": "\"电力熔炼炉或熔炼工厂\"" }, count: 1, id: "ftbfiltersystem:smart_filter" }
